title: Sandstorm of Witnesses
description: Aten Ra advances through floodplain mirrors, collapsing bridges, and corrupted river channels while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and formation answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: floodplain mirrors, collapsing bridges, and corrupted river channels

objectives.primary: Clear the field while maintaining formation near river-light cover.
optional: Trigger at least two faction synergy actions

specialRules: Mirror Orders: enemies copy the last objective interaction unless interrupted.
Anchor Corruption: structures worsen hazards every two turns.
victoryConditions: Clear the field while maintaining formation near river-light cover.

stars.one: Primary completed with one Titan standing or severe turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
